podcast.body: Drummer Jim Gordon is officially credited with co-writing the iconic song "Layla" alongside Eric Clapton, a significant contribution to Derek and the Dominos' acclaimed catalog. "Drummer Jim Gordon, co-wrote Leila with Eric Clapton and Derek in the Dominoes."

podcast.body: Eric Clapton's "fiery" hit with Derek and the Dominos was later covered in a slowed-down, unplugged version by Clapton himself, which became a big chart hit and earned him Grammy recognition. "his fiery Derek and the Domino's hit, Leila."

podcast.body: Jim Gordon was the drummer on the iconic Derek and the Dominos track, "Layla." "Jim Gordon, the guy playing drums on that track, took a hammer and knife to his mother. She's dead, he's still in prison."

podcast.body: This song was the single hit from the album "Layla and Other Assorted Love Songs" and was co-written by drummer Jim Gordon. It became a timeless track. "There was just a single hit from the album, but it was one for the ages. Laila, which Jim Gordon co-rode."
